scope: Classifier head only (StandardScaler + LogisticRegression, 385 params), input = already-extracted 384-dim Whisper mean-pooled feature vector. Does NOT include audio preprocessing or Whisper-tiny encoder forward pass, which require network access to huggingface.co that is unavailable in this sandbox.
note_on_full_pipeline_latency: The README's existing anecdotal 38.2ms end-to-end CLI number (audio load + Whisper-tiny forward pass + classifier) was measured in an earlier session that had model/network access; it could not be reproduced or re-benchmarked here. A real, sweepable 1/2/4/6/8s-duration end-to-end benchmark requires the Whisper encoder, which this sandbox cannot download.
durations_swept: NOT RUN -- requires loading real audio at varying durations through the Whisper-tiny encoder, which requires huggingface.co access unavailable in this sandbox. Command to run elsewhere: `python scripts/benchmark_latency_full_pipeline.py --durations 1,2,4,6,8` (to be written once encoder access exists).
gpu: NOT RUN -- no GPU present in this sandbox (CPU-only container) and no encoder available to benchmark anyway.
